limitationTriage.limitation: Results hold for exact stationary Gaussian dynamics only.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Is there a perturbative ordering statement for near-Gaussian targets?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Requires control of couplings between chaos degrees (replacement for (M5)); no known theorem supplies it.

limitationTriage.limitation: No discrete-time (integrator) criterion; regular sampling can alias.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: What is the exact criterion for a specified splitting integrator with rotation?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Section 9.3 gives the exact aliasing mechanism; no general rule.

limitationTriage.limitation: N(gamma) in Theorem 4A is given by existence; Table 1 values are computed, not proved.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Can N(gamma) or the crossing points be certified?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Exact exponential-sum formula with quadrature cross-check, odd degrees scanned to 201.
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: Certification needs interval arithmetic over unbounded families.
limitationTriage.whyNotClosedNow: The theorem does not depend on the table.

limitationTriage.limitation: Unmatched rotations and phase-space observables are outside the ordering theorem.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Does any ordering survive for unmatched rotations?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Section 9.1 shows momentum observables fail; precision-mismatch formula checked in verify_matrix_extension.py.

limitationTriage.limitation: Verification scripts could silently pass under python -O if they relied on assert.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Do the scripts fail when a check is wrong, including under -O?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: All checks raise RuntimeError; replayed with and without -O; release gate includes a semantic negative control.
